payload.reason: The evidence provides specific improvement margins for the Zero-Shot Adaptive Transfer method in slot tagging, indicating the performance gains over existing models.

claims.text: The Zero-Shot Adaptive Transfer method shows an improvement of 7.24% in absolute F1-score when training with 2000 instances.
The improvement margin increases to 14.57% in absolute F1-score when only 500 training instances are used.
ZAT shows an improvement of 14.67 in absolute F1-score over CRF when training with 500 instances.
